join.conditionInput: raw record.params; date from official historyDate or returned event.date
join.onMissing: keep event.summary and confirmed date; do not infer required slots or fabricate subject

identity.age: Base selector: use only validated event params.age. Optional historical-age adapter proposal may derive ageAtRecord from the same raw history record ID, official event date, and uniquely resolved birth year under its contract. Never use current biography header age; unsupported or ambiguous records fall back.

estateOnlyPersons.reason: personById searches persons.people, persons.past and factions only

historicalAgeExtension.priority: The base conditionSources contract remains unchanged. Only an explicitly adopted validated extension may supply ageAtRecord; unknown never becomes zero or current age.
historicalAgeExtension.householdEvents: Do not attach an individual age to household events.
